**s21-track (26.3 s)**
Emotion/story 2 · Sound-off 2 · Pacing 2 · Composition 3

1. **2.6 s:** The frame holds only the house and Tessa while the "shortcut" line plays. Nothing happens on screen. Fix: start laying the track tiles from the house on "Back" (0.7 s) so the scene opens with movement.
2. **13.2–18.4 s:** The 15 gold overflow tiles are already past the wall while only 5 of the 15 columns are lit. The picture says "late" before the payments get there, so the cause and effect are reversed. Fix: run the fill all the way to the wall first, then spill the gold tiles one after another starting on "late" (16.6 s).
3. **23.7 s:** There's no visible extra slab. The tiles look the same as before and the gold overflow just vanishes, so the fix only exists in the caption. Fix: give each tile a thin coloured slab on top, sweep it across the grid on "add" (19.9 s), and pull the overflow back to the wall.
4. **All frames:** The "Freddie Mac weekly mortgage survey" header doesn't match this scene. "ILLUSTRATIVE" appears twice. From 13 s the overhead camera shrinks Tessa to a speck, and the caption at 23.7 s touches the top row. Fix: drop the header, keep one "ILLUSTRATIVE" tag, use a lower camera angle so Tessa stays readable, and move the caption up.

**s23-track (14.1 s)**
Emotion/story 2 · Sound-off 3 · Pacing 2 · Composition 3

1. **1.4–4.2 s:** The same lit grid sits still for about 6 s, and the monthly-slab version is never shown, so there's nothing to compare against. Fix: open on thin slabs on every tile, then on "once a year" (4.3 s) have each column's slabs merge into one block.
2. **7.0–9.9 s:** The grid turns from lit white to grey with no reason given, and the blocks sit at the top row instead of on every 12th tile. Fix: keep the grid's colour the same and put each block on the last tile of its year.
3. **7.0 s:** "$8,792" doesn't match the narration. $733 × 12 = $8,796, so an attentive viewer will think it's an error. Fix: show $8,796 on screen, or change the narration to "about $733".
4. **12.7 s:** The 4 gold tiles are small and partly hidden behind the wall, and the caption is doing the explaining. Fix: dolly in to the wall and drop in the 4 tiles one at a time on "four months later" (11.5–12.1 s).
